as_told.title: Experimental substances given at the facility

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at a facility called Baker Victory Services in Western New York, a boy named Jordan Jose says he was given drugs his parents never knew about. Jose, who says a secret UFO program took him as a child, tells it from his own experience: he says his medical records "do not reflect what was being administered inside the facility", that there were "all sorts of substances", and that he was "essentially an experiment".
